title: Costume 솔로 #094 · Polynesian goddess · 바니걸 · 힙 팝 · 봄 정원 테라스 · 히메갸루
prompt:

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, Polynesian goddess physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person; a powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere; thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing; her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame; solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids auburn hair — wearing a minimal black satin playboy-bunny costume of two small opaque molded cups joined by a thin plunging V strip that runs down to her belly button, a tiny high-cut opaque bottom cut up to her hip bones, a small white bow-tie collar and wrist cuffs, tall black bunny ears and a fluffy white tail, the small opaque pieces fully covering her, her stomach bare. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme Polynesian goddess silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy black satin, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy black satin with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.

Background: a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
